name: browsersolver-mcp
description: BrowserSolver web unlocker API for Claude.
long_description: Unlock, render, crawl and screenshot any website — anti-bot bypass and technology detection through one API.

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Infrastructure health for an engine or endpoint over the last hour. Not scoped to your account or tenant. Enabled per account: HTTP 403 means contact support to activate it.

tools.name: usage
tools.description: Retrieve real-time usage statistics and credit balance for your BrowserSolver account.

tools.name: website_antibot
tools.description: Single-pass scan that names the bot-protection vendor in front of a URL so you can choose the right BrowserSolver fetch tier next.

tools.name: website_crawler
tools.description: Fast HTTP pull of public HTML with no browser session. Ideal when the first response already contains the content you need.

tools.name: website_rendering
tools.description: Run a managed browser session against a public URL and collect the HTML after client-side scripts finish. Prefer Crawler for static markup; escalate to WebUnlocker on approved hosts when challenges p…

tools.name: website_screenshot
tools.description: Turn any public URL into a PNG, JPEG, WebP, or PDF asset rendered by BrowserSolver. No local Chromium fleet to operate.

tools.name: website_technology
tools.description: Map CMS, frameworks, analytics, CDN, and security tooling exposed by a public URL. Choose simple lists or expert metadata with confidence scores.

tools.name: website_webunlocker
tools.description: BrowserSolver's highest HTML fetch tier for retail and marketplace hosts on your account whitelist. Solves persistent bot challenges that still block Rendering.
